summary: Verified the two reported fixes end-to-end. (1) WEB Landing logo: /workhop-logo.png is served (200, 175017 bytes) and rendered as inside [data-testid='landing-logo'] on both the role-picker landing (naturalWidth=640, complete=true) and the sign-in screen reached via the I'M HIRING role card (same image, verified after 3s wait). (2) WEB Admin: EMPLOYERS tab present between USERS and PROS (data-testid='admin-tab-employers'), EMPLOYERS stat visible in the overview strip (value 16), clicking the tab renders 16 employer accounts (data-testid='admin-employer-0..15') and 52 hiring-activity devices (data-testid='admin-employer-device-0..51'). All other tabs (USERS/PROS/PAYMENTS/ISSUES/COUPONS) still load without admin-error. Backend GET /api/admin/employers returns {accounts:[...], devices:[...]} 200 with admin bearer, 401 without token, 403 for non-admin session; GET /api/admin/overview 200 and includes 'employers':15 field. MOBILE Admin: code inspection of /app/mobile/app/admin.tsx confirms parity — TABS array includes EMPLOYERS between USERS and PROS, Stat label 'EMPLOYERS' bound to overview.employers, EmployersTab renders accounts + devices with testIDs admin-employer-{i} and admin-employer-device-{i}, and load() maps EMPLOYERS -> /employers. However, the mobile Expo web preview at https://payment-mgmt-10.expo.preview.emergentagent.com cannot exercise the admin flow via a browser because the preview ingress returns a mismatched Access-Control-Allow-Origin ('...cluster-2.preview.emergentcf.cloud') on OPTIONS preflights, so all cross-origin fetches from the mobile web preview fail. This is a pre-existing preview-env infra issue, not a regression from the current fixes; the mobile source is correct and should work in a native build or once CORS is fixed.

minor.issue: Preview ingress rewrites Access-Control-Allow-Origin to a hardcoded 'https://payment-mgmt-10.cluster-2.preview.emergentcf.cloud' regardless of the incoming Origin header. Because backend has allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True (which browsers already reject), and the ingress overrides ACAO with an unrelated origin, any cross-origin browser fetch is blocked. Same-origin calls (web /app/frontend from payment-mgmt-10.preview.emergentagent.com) skip CORS and therefore work. Recommend: set explicit allow_origins list including 'https://payment-mgmt-10.preview.emergentagent.com' and 'https://payment-mgmt-10.expo.preview.emergentagent.com' and drop 'allow_credentials=True' with '*', and/or fix the ingress override.

integration_issues.flow: Mobile web preview admin flow (any authenticated flow, actually)
integration_issues.issue: Every cross-origin fetch from expo.preview.emergentagent.com to preview.emergentagent.com/api is blocked because ACAO on OPTIONS is rewritten to an unrelated origin. Admin gate therefore renders 'ADMIN ACCESS ONLY' even after seeding the correct session_token in localStorage. Root cause is preview ingress + backend CORS config, not the admin code. Testing in a native Expo build (which does not enforce browser CORS) would work.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_employers() correctly excludes MongoDB _id (uses projection {'_id':0}) and derives employer accounts by set-differencing freelancer emails. Fine.

The web+mobile admin dashboards duplicate a lot of code (TABS, load(), Stat/Card/Badge). Consider extracting a shared config to keep tabs in sync across surfaces so future 'EMPLOYERS'-style additions stay in parity by default.
Backend CORS: allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is a well-known misconfiguration — browsers ignore it. See action_items.

rca of the issue: N/A — no defects in the two fixes under test. The mobile-preview blocker is an infrastructure/CORS issue traced to (i) the Emergent preview ingress rewriting ACAO to an unrelated origin, and (ii) backend CORSMiddleware using allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True (which browsers reject).
